description: This file defines the pBarcode128 class, which is used to generate Code 128 barcodes, including functions for encoding, size calculation, and drawing barcodes using a chart object.

classes.name: pBarcode128
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering Code 128 barcodes, including encoding, size estimation, and graphical rendering methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes barcode codes by loading data from a database file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the projected size (width and height) of a barcode for a given string and format.

methods.name: encode128
methods.description: Encodes a string into Code 128 barcode format, producing a binary pattern and computing CRC.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode on a given chart object at specified position with formatting options.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the leftmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost N characters of a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a specific position with a specified length.
